senses.gloss: (v. חפף I) to put on as a cover; to tilt over, invert.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 104a:6">Snh. 104ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A00529"><he>אוכלא</he></cite> (<cite ref="A00528"><he>אובלא</he></cite>) … <he>ס׳ ארישיה</he> he inverted a fuller’s trough over his head.
<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:1">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>וסַחְפֵּיה על רישיה</he> and tilted it over &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:2">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>ולִיסְחוֹף דיקולא ארישיה</he> (Ms. M. incorr. <he>וליחסוף</he>) and let him put a basket over his head.
<cite ref="Chullin 8b:11">Ḥull. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>לא ליס׳ … כפלי וכ׳</he> one must not cover up meat with groins; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>סְחִיף</he>; f. <cite ref="O00458"><he>סְחִיפָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 51b">Ab. Zar. 51ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02882"><he>מְשִׁיכְלָא</he></cite>. Ḥag, 15ᵃ <he>כתרי כסי דסְחִיפֵי אהדדי</he> (Rashi <he>דסחופין</he>, read: <he>דסחי׳</he>) like two cups inverted one over the other.—V. <cite ref="O00458"><he>סְחִיפָא</he></cite>.
